cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Back My Version
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to remember, repeat, and defend one shared version of events when questions begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put a spoon upside down beside yours. Judges' tasting done. Remember, we both made this jam from scratch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's upside down because it's dirty. Yours still has the supermarket label on the jar.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Labels off before tasting, naturally. We both cooked the apples into it; let's start there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won't say we made the strawberry part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say 'our apple and strawberry recipe'. Practise it once so we don't offer two different jams.
